title: ODIN pipeline scripts: command-line workflows for pathogen, antimicrobial resistance, Mpox and qPCR analysis of environmental samples
description: Command-line scripts for the ODIN environmental surveillance workflows, as run in the 2025 ODIN mobile laboratory deployments: Kraken 2 taxonomic profiling with nf-core/taxprofiler, antimicrobial resistance (AMR) gene detection with epi2me-labs/wf-metagenomics, Mpox consensus and phylogenetic analysis, and Biomeme qPCR processing. Metadata-driven: runs, samples and sites are read from the ODIN metadata workbook, and results are written as Feather and Excel datasets for analysis and the Enlighten viewer.
